source_prompt:
# Instructions for accurately documenting a failed industrial safety audit

1. Start with the inspection records.
2.
completion:
Briefly summarize the purpose of the audit.
3. Identify which regulations or compliance standards were used to perform the audit.
4. List all areas and equipment that were inspected.
5. Document observed discrepancies.
   - Specify each violation with reference to the relevant code or standard.
   - Include photographs or sketches where possible to support your findings.
   - Use credible, objective language and avoid opinions or assumptions.
6. Provide details about interviews conducted with employees.
   - Record responses to specific questions about safety procedures and policies.
   - Note any observations regarding worker training, knowledge, and compliance with safety requirements.
7. Detail any tests performed on safety equipment or systems.
   - Include data and results from these tests.
   - Record any calibration or validation procedures that were, or should have been, followed.
8. Outline any immediate corrective actions taken.
   - Document all actions taken by the organization post-audit, if applicable.
   - Record whether the situation
